closedReason.description: Recorded closure reason or null if unset.

currentRunId.description: Live run identifier or null if none.

triggerConfig.description: Unchanged per-run payload and execution settings when returned.

tags.description: Per-run tags, distinct from row tags.

items.description: A per-run tag.

basePayload.description: Base payload passed to each session run.

FunctionOutput_trigger_dev_updatesession.description: The updated session with structured metadata and UTC timestamps.

tags.instructions: Use a session ID from `list-sessions` or your externalId; no lookup is needed first. Requires a secret-key connection, not a session public token. Omitted tags/metadata remain unchanged; [] clears tags, null clears metadata, and {} sets empty metadata. External identity, type and trigger configuration cannot be changed here. Use `close-session` for terminal closure.

functions.name: update-webhook-endpoint-secret
functions.description: Replace an existing webhook endpoint's signing secret or public key with a supplied value, optionally retaining the previous credential for up to seven days.

secret.description: Replacement signing secret or public key as ordinary text, 1–4,096 characters; leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed, while internal newlines are preserved.

endpointId.description: Existing endpoint's declared ID in this environment or generated wh_ ID.

previousSecretTtlSeconds.description: Seconds the replaced credential remains valid for verification, at most seven days; default 0 replaces it immediately.

FunctionInput_trigger_dev_updatewebhooke.description: Replace the signing credential of an existing webhook endpoint, with an optional grace period.

id.description: Generated wh_ ID of the updated existing endpoint.

secretSet.description: The endpoint has a stored signing secret or public key; the value is not echoed.

previousSecretExpiresAt.description: UTC instant when the replaced credential stops verifying; omitted after immediate replacement.

FunctionOutput_trigger_dev_updatewebhook.description: Updated endpoint credential readiness and the previous credential expiry, without the credential itself.

tags.instructions: Use for an existing endpoint with a provider-issued secret or public key; inspect the endpoint with `get-webhook-endpoint` first. This replaces its stored credential. Omitted or zero grace invalidates the old credential immediately. Use `rotate-webhook-endpoint-secret` to generate a replacement secret instead. The tool does not configure an external sender or create or renew a subscription.
